project_type: FileForgeWorkbench -- Rust Cargo workspace; egui/eframe desktop GUI (ffwb binary in crate ff-desktop) plus ~90 member crates; SCRM capture split across egui-free ff-screen-model + ff-scrm.
build_system: Cargo workspace. default-members narrowed to ~32 core crates (true-core strip). Touched crates ff-screen-model and ff-desktop are both in default-members. Pinned deps: egui 0.33 / eframe 0.33 (glow default renderer, feature default_fonts) resolved to egui 0.33.3; egui_kittest 0.33 (feature eframe) for GUI tests; png =0.18.1 (ff-screen-model); clipboard-win =5.4.3 (ff-desktop, cfg(windows) only).
test_framework: cargo test (built-in) with pretty_assertions and tempfile; egui_kittest for full-shell GUI harness tests. No nextest required for scoped runs.
test_command: cargo test -p ff-screen-model ; cargo test -p ff-desktop clipboard_backend clipboard_html screenshot commands_snapshot
verification_instructions: Per gate-policy.md: on every change run the SCOPED trio on the touched crate(s) and READ the logs -- cargo check -p <crate>, cargo clippy -p <crate> -- -D warnings, cargo fmt -p <crate> -- --check -- plus quick scoped tests. An AGENT compile-verifies and runs scoped tests only; it MUST NOT run the whole suite or cargo gate (testing.md execution split). The authoritative full cargo gate (fmt+clippy+build+whole-suite) and the manual 'picture pastes into Word' check are the OWNER's manual runs. Verify by effect: redirect long output to a unique log under _ignore/logs/ and read it back; never trust a bare Exit Code -1.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None. No generated/snapshot files are checked in for these crates.
environment_constraints: WORKTREE is c:/workspace/apps/FileForgeWorkbench/.worktrees/scrm-2b-picture-clipboard on branch scrm-2b -- WORK THERE; do NOT create a new worktree; no merge, no push. CRITICAL: the editor repo-wide search tools (grep_search/file_search) and the workspace ROOT (c:/workspace/apps/FileForgeWorkbench) are a DIFFERENT checkout WITHOUT the Phase 2B code; read/edit files via the absolute worktree path and confirm by reading the worktree file, never trust a repo-wide grep 'no matches'. Terminal is proxied/mangle-prone: use the pwsh7 non-interactive wrapper, redirect to a UNIQUE log, read it back. A headless host CANNOT assert the Win32 clipboard contract or a live window screenshot -- those are owner-manual.
contribution_requirements: No source .rs over 400 non-test lines (new screenshot acquisition and CF_HTML builder go in their OWN modules); functions ~40 lines. Pin any new dep EXACT (none expected -- CF_HTML reuses clipboard-win 5.4.3; base64 implemented in-module). ASCII-only in SOURCE and DOCS: Unicode box glyphs (U+2500 family) may appear ONLY in RUNTIME OUTPUT strings/renderer, built from char constants ('\u{2500}' etc.) -- never raw box glyphs in doc comments or test literals; build expected glyphs from constants in tests. Every test carries a // Validates: comment. framework-conformance: single command dispatch seam, no bespoke intercept, no second dispatcher.
key_patterns: Deferred-action frame-loop pattern: the command path sets a small pending field on the shell (see pending_menu_option / pending_tab_actions in shell/state.rs), and shell/update.rs drains it with the live egui ctx. egui 0.33 window screenshot is ASYNC: ctx.send_viewport_cmd(egui::ViewportCommand::Screenshot(egui::UserData::default())) requests it; the image arrives a LATER frame as egui::Event::Screenshot { image: Arc<egui::ColorImage>, user_data, .. } read via ctx.input(|i| &i.raw.events). image.as_raw() = RGBA8 row-major top-left. DIB/PNG reuse: clipboard_backend::raster_to_dib / raster_to_dib_v5 build CF_DIB(8)/CF_DIBV5(17) from a ff_screen_model::RasterImage { width:u32,height:u32,rgba:Vec<u8> }; ff_screen_model::encode_png encodes PNG. Multi-flavor transaction: OsClipboard::place opens the Windows clipboard once (clipboard_win::Clipboard::new_attempts(10)), then raw::set_without_clear per format (CF_UNICODETEXT=13, CF_DIB=8, CF_DIBV5=17, registered PNG); add CF_HTML via raw::register_format("HTML Format"). Unicode box glyphs already exist in render/text.rs::Glyphs; Part B is flipping markdown.rs's fenced-block RenderOptions{unicode_box:false} to true.
